name: verification-skills
description: Generate and maintain a private verify-<project> skill that drives a web app, CLI, service or dbt/Snowflake project the way a user does and records evidence a reviewer can check. Invoke-only. Adapted from pstack (MIT).

interface.shortDescription: Create and maintain a per-project verify skill
interface.longDescription: Generates a private verify-<project> skill with launch, doctor, drive, evidence and cleanup steps plus a feature map, proves it once end to end, and keeps it honest with a periodic source-and-live pass. Evidence records the revision, action, result, side effects, mocks and gaps, and an unreachable feature never counts as passed.
defaultPrompt: Create a verification skill for this repo.
Maintain the verify skill for this project.
